scope: All 27 Auth relation-backed PostgreSQL composite rowtypes, complete declared attributes, table constraints as related source, metadata, dependencies, reciprocal array and client permissions; no data/credentials/#267 source line review
direct_provider_sql:
WITH r AS (SELECT c.oid rel_oid,c.relname,c.relkind,c.relrowsecurity,c.relforcerowsecurity,t.oid type_oid,t.typarray,t.typacl,t.typlen,t.typalign,t.typstorage,t.typcategory,t.typnotnull,t.typisdefined,pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner) owner FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.typrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname='auth' AND t.typtype='c' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f')),
details AS (
SELECT 'auth' AS schema_name,r.relname AS relation_name,r.rel_oid,r.type_oid,r.typarray,r.owner,r.relkind,r.relrowsecurity,r.relforcerowsecurity,
jsonb_build_object('typlen',r.typlen,'typalign',r.typalign,'typstorage',r.typstorage,'typcategory',r.typcategory,'typnotnull',r.typnotnull,'typisdefined',r.typisdefined,'typacl',r.typacl) AS type_properties,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('ordinal',a.attnum,'name',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'type_oid',a.atttypid,'typmod',a.atttypmod,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'identity',a.attidentity,'generated',a.attgenerated,'ndims',a.attndims,'collation',CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 THEN null ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END,'storage',a.attstorage,'compression',a.attcompression,'acl',a.attacl) ORDER BY a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE a.attrelid=r.rel_oid AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped) AS complete_attributes,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',x.conname,'kind',x.contype,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(x.oid,true)) ORDER BY x.conname) FROM pg_constraint x WHERE x.conrelid=r.rel_oid) AS related_table_constraints,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('type',d.deptype,'class',d.classid::regclass::text,'refclass',d.refclassid::regclass::text,'refobjid',d.refobjid) ORDER BY d.deptype) FROM pg_depend d WHERE d.classid='pg_type'::regclass AND d.objid=r.type_oid) AS direct_type_dependencies,
(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_depend d WHERE d.refclassid='pg_type'::regclass AND d.refobjid=r.type_oid AND d.deptype NOT IN ('i','a')) AS other_type_dependent_count,
(SELECT tt.typelem=r.type_oid AND tt.typcategory='A' FROM pg_type tt WHERE tt.oid=r.typarray) AS reciprocal_array_type,
jsonb_build_object('anon_schema_usage',has_schema_privilege('anon','auth','USAGE'),'anon_type_usage',has_type_privilege('anon',r.type_oid,'USAGE'),'anon_table_select',has_table_privilege('anon',r.rel_oid,'SELECT'),'auth_schema_usage',has_schema_privilege('authenticated','auth','USAGE'),'auth_type_usage',has_type_privilege('authenticated',r.type_oid,'USAGE'),'auth_table_select',has_table_privilege('authenticated',r.rel_oid,'SELECT'),'service_table_select',has_table_privilege('service_role',r.rel_oid,'SELECT')) AS direct_effective_permissions
FROM r)
SELECT *, md5(to_jsonb(details)::text) AS provider_definition_md5 FROM details ORDER BY relation_name
